firstNightReminder: The Manager might choose a player. Show them that player's character. :reminder:
otherNightReminder: The Manager might choose a player. Show them that player's character. :reminder:
name: Manager - π
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a non-Traveller player: you learn their character. Chosen Townsfolk are drunk, even if you die.
flavor: I'll withhold a thousand wages before I give up my bonuses!

name: Optimist - π
ability: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any question & learn some answers (only 1 is correct).
flavor: We don't matter in the eyes of nature but what about the eyes of those we fight for? Even in the worst of times there is still hope, some answers. Something.

otherNightReminder: You may choose a Minion. :reminder: Wake the Warden and nod. Put them to sleep. Wake the Minion and show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token then the Warden token. Run their ability twice.
name: Warden - π
ability: Each night, if you died, a Minion's ability might work twice until dusk. You & they learn this.
flavor: Times up ladies! Back to your cells!

jinxes.reason: The Marionette does not learn they are affected by the Warden's ability.
A Warden boosted Mezepheles cannot create 2 evil players.
If the Summoner's ability works twice due to the Warden, the second Demon they create retains their alignment. If the Summoner creates 2 evil Demons, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

name: Celebrity - π
ability: If you die & 5 or more non-Travellers live, choose an alive player: if they are not executed tomorrow, your team loses.
flavor: Marvelous photos darling just marvelous. Now go away, I have a show to star!

jinxes.reason: If the Celebrity chooses the same player as the Hagumoth, the Celebrity is poisoned.

name: Celebrity - π
ability: If you die & 5 or more non-Travellers live, choose an alive player: if they are not executed tomorrow, your team loses.
flavor: Marvelous photos darling just marvelous. Now go away, I have a show to star!

jinxes.reason: If the Celebrity chooses the same player as the Hagumoth, the Celebrity is poisoned.

otherNightReminder: The Corrupted might choose 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Say "The Corrupted has chosen", then both players' names, then start the silent vote. Afterwards, add and remove shrouds from both players accordingly.
name: Corrupted - π
ability: Twice per game, at night*, choose 2 players: all vote for who lives & dies. The 1st time the Demon dies, play for 1 more night.
flavor: Do not worry, your death will be swift and painless.

jinxes.reason: If a Demon is resurrected, deaths tonight are arbitrary. If a Demon dies and the game continues anyway, it does not count.

otherNightReminder: The Zhobazhbu chooses a player. :reminder:. If that player is a Minion, reverse Townsfolk info. :reminder: :reminder:
name: Zhobazhbu - π
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & reverse Townsfolk info. [-1 Outsider]
flavor: Bathe within the flames, such that they purify thee of thy sin of weakness and frailty. Through atonement for thy mortality thou shalt be embraced by The One Beyond.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon kills the Banshee, players still learn that they have died.

otherNightReminder: The Sabnock chooses a player. :reminder: If that player is an Outsider, poison a neighboring Townsfolk. :reminder: :reminder:
name: Sabnock - π
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Outsiders you kill poison the closest Townsfolk neighbor to you. [+1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: Traumas created by its own ability do not register as Outsiders to the Sabnock.

name: Madeline - π
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk equal to the night's number (maximum of 3) clockwise to you are poisoned.
flavor: If only you knew your place! But its too late now!
